steps.note: Before anything is stamped, `get provenance docs/limits.md` reads the record from git.
Record an agent's edit: with MANNI_GENERATED_BY (or `--generated-by`) set, `derive` attributes the uncommitted lines.
After committing the edit and its stamp, `get` shows the record as asserted.
A range git already attributes to another machine is refused.
Attribute lines by hand: `derive docs/limits.md:17 --generated-by claude-sonnet-5`.
When a person edits machine text and commits, validate fails at the range.
The fix the message names: `derive` re-derives the range.

scaffolding: docs/limits.md is the page's example (test/fixtures/derive/provenance), and manni.config.yaml declares collection `site` with a permissive schema but does not yet manage provenance: the reader adds `derive:` (fields, sources, machines). The workspace is one commit with no machine trailer, so the first `get` reads `(unset)`. The page's story has the reader make the agent's edit, commit with its stamp, attribute a line by hand, and commit a person's copy edit, so a spec edits docs/limits.md and commits with git between the runs. The pre-commit hook needs pre-commit, and the moved-range, unstamped-trailer, manifest, HTML and fill transcripts are other setups, so none is expected.
